span.p:
Person fills in the
sign-up or sign-in form

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Safety check:
is the form genuine and
not being sent over and over?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stop and ask them
to try again shortly

span.p:
Are the name and
email filled in properly?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is the password strong?
8+ characters, a capital letter,
a number and a symbol

span.p:
Scramble the password so the
real one is never stored,
then create the account

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Signed in: show
their account page

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is sign-in locked after

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ask them to try again
in 15 minutes

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Are the email and
password correct?

span.p:

the page they wanted
